newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine stocks seen up, profit-taking possible.
newsitem.headline: Argentine stocks seen up, profit-taking possible.

text.p: Argentine stocks were expected to open higher Thursday, in the wake of gains on Wall Street and lower U.S. Treasury yields, said traders.
Still, after gains of 4.34 percent in the last three sessions traders warned there could be some profit-taking.
"The gains have been strong, which means the market's performance could be uneven," said Jorge Bonanno, an analyst at brokers Interfin.
"After an initial push, I would expect some declines after the recent gains."
The blue chip Merval stock index rose 1.31 percent to 715.93 points Wednesday.
Another trader said the market would get its main impulse from the decline in the U.S. 30-year Treasury yield. It was last down four basis points at 7.06 percent.
Players suggested the 30-year bond yield could decline further in coming days, which would lend more support to Argentine stocks.
